# Pinned TUN design components

Source: [TUN Systemic Design commit 81b52e8](https://github.com/kochrisdev/TUN-Systemic-Design/tree/81b52e8d64c90891ef1340802502e398dc6c0340).

This is a minimal source subset for ApprovalGate and ActionReceipt, with their shared contracts and styles. Source content is unchanged apart from normalized trailing whitespace at file end and line endings. tokens.css comes from styles/tun.css. Other source files retain their original basename from packages/react/src. The upstream [CC0 license](LICENSE) is retained separately from this repository's MIT license.

No published npm package is assumed. The engineering host's projections are implemented separately; vendored components do not authorize execution. Review upstream changes before replacing this pinned subset.
